method: Use advertised amount where known; otherwise a labelled mean of matched nearby advertisements, not an asserted neighbourhood-wide average. Never substitute zero silently. Maintain a repair reserve even where no monthly strata collection is advertised.

strata_monthly.basis: Mean of three advertisements explicitly claiming no strata fees; mixed ages and sizes, not verified strata budgets. Subject marketing also claims no maintenance fee. Actual shared insurance/repair liabilities remain unknown.

annual_tax.geography: Coquitlam townhouse city-level proxy; not a Maillardville neighbourhood average
annual_tax.basis: Subject listing reports $0, treated as missing rather than tax-free. Two known townhouse taxes from the city provide a rough annual allowance; different ages/areas, not a representative local average. Replace with current notice.
